metadata.scope: Three pilot destinations; Jetty Road address scope is narrower than the source district directory.

definitions.record: A distinct source directory listing, not necessarily a unique brand, premises or tenancy.
definitions.listing_status: Published listing or explicit coming-soon label; not independent proof of current trading.
definitions.source_effective_date: Unknown unless the source dates the underlying fact. CMS publication dates are retained separately.
definitions.categories: Conservative crosswalk of source categories; combined source categories remain combined. Multiple categories may apply.
definitions.shares: No tenancy-count or floor-area shares: compatible physical-tenancy and area denominators are unavailable.
definitions.optical: Reviewed identity links reuse the canonical census; no optical census record or place membership is added by this database.
